description: This file defines an Angular component called NoteEditorComponent, which provides functionality for editing and deleting notes within the application. It includes input properties for receiving a note object and output events for saving or deleting the note.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for editing notes, emitting save and delete events based on user actions.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with the current note when the user triggers a save action.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Emits the delete event with the note's id when the user triggers a delete action.
